name: ListRouteTargetGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of route target group IDs.

You can specify up to 50 instance IDs in a single query
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组实例ID列表。

单次查询最多支持传入50个实例ID
parameters.name: route_target_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of a route target group member instance. This parameter filters route target groups that contain the specified member instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组成员实例ID。
筛选成员包含传入成员实例ID的路由目标组
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~50，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If not all results are returned in a query, a value is returned for NextToken. In the next query, set NextToken to this value
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 路由目标组所属的VPC的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see What is a resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见什么是资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
